newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Marieberg seen divesting Duni - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Marieberg seen divesting Duni - analysts.

text.p: Suspension of trading in the shares of Tidnings AB Marieberg on Thursday is probably connected with an announcemnt about the divestment or partial sale of its subsidiary Duni, analysts said.

The Swedish media group "is certain to mention Duni" in its nine-month results statement due out on Thursday, according to one analyst. "Either they will have found a buyer for the whole unit or a part-owner," the analyst added.
A second analyst said signals from Marieberg indicated it would keep Duni within the group but might have found a financial partner.
According to a third analyst, Marieberg's dilemma was that it had bought the Duni stake at the top of the market and needed to demonstrate that it had been a wise purchase.
Other possible explanations for the trading suspension were that Marieberg might increase its stake in Finnish media group Aamulehti or make an announcement about a proposed Nordic news channel.
